content:
If you’re looking for a nice balance between a crossbody and a backpack when traveling or camping, you might be interesting to take a look at the Spigen Snapzip Mag Fit. I recently picked one up and am looking forward to using it while traveling. It can hold your AirPods, keys, cash, and much more. It’s like a mini backpack for your iPhone.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers looks at the latest and greatest in the MagSafe and wireless charging industry to help you get the most out of your Apple devices that support wireless charging.

A great travel companion

The Snapzip Mag Fit is essentially a miniature everyday carry pouch that attaches right to your iPhone. It is built from highly durable ripstop nylon and features a smooth two-way zipper. Inside the main section, there is plenty of room for charging cables, extra credit cards, and cash. It also features a dedicated front pocket that is the exact right size for your AirPods, plus a small spandex side pocket for Chapstick.

When you are spending a long day exploring a theme park or navigating a busy city on vacation, you really do not want to carry a backpack. At the same time, stuffing all of those small items into your pockets is uncomfortable and a great way to lose something. This pouch sits right in that sweet spot, letting you carry the daily essentials while staying incredibly light and organized.

Multiple ways to use it

Magnet-wise, it’s not as strong as some of the wallets I’ve tried, but I was able to hold my iPhone with the Spigen Snapzip Mag Fit, and it never slipped off. Spigen included a few other carrying options outside of MagSafe. There is a carabiner at the bottom, so you can easily clip the pouch to a belt loop or hook it onto a larger travel bag or backpack.

Wrap up on Spigen Snapzip Mag Fit

So far, I love the Spigen Snapzip Mag Fit. I struggle when traveling between wanting a crossbody pack and not really having enough to justify it. With it on, your iPhone won’t fit in your pocket, but that’s one of the trade-offs of being able to hold all your stuff. For theme parks, days at the beach, or walking around a new city, the Spigen Snapzip Mag Fit is a unique way to carry your stuff.

You can buy it from Amazon or directly from Spigen.
